1 Libraries and data

Code 
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(tidyverse)))
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(patchwork)))
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(readxl)))
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(lme4)))
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(library(gt)))

cbPalette <- c( "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73", "#CC79A7",
                "#F0E442", "#56B4E9", "#999999", "#E69F00")

m_sd <- function(x,y){paste0(round(mean(x, na.rm = y),1), " ± ", round(sd(x, na.rm = y),1))}

load("data/Data.rda")
load("data/subj.rda")

dat_b <- Data |> 
  select(Subj, date, leg, can_b, gender2, a1, wd, hd, jd) 

dat_l <- Data |> 
  filter(can_b == 1 & !is.na(loc_b))

2.1 baseline/followup characteristics

2.1.1 aud, cudit & audit

mean values

Code 
dat_desc <- Data |> 
  select(Subj) |> 
  unique() |> 
  left_join(dat.subj_FA)

dat_desc|> 
  group_by(leg) |> 
  reframe(auditc = m_sd(auditc,F),
          aud = m_sd(aud,F),
          cudit = m_sd(cudit,F)) |> 
  pivot_longer(2:4) |> 
  spread(leg, value) |> 
  select(name,pre,post) |> 
  gt()

2.2 baseline/followup

Cannabis consumption characteristics

Code 
dat_b |> 
  group_by(leg) |> 
  reframe(N = n_distinct(Subj),
          n = n(),
          can_b = sum(can_b),
          can_r = round(can_b/n*100,1)) |> 
  left_join(
    dat_l |> 
      group_by(leg) |> 
      reframe(can_g2 = paste0(round(mean(can_g),2), "±", round(sd(can_g),2)))
  ) |> 
  gt()
leg N n can_b can_r can_g2
pre 49 1535 696 45.3 0.43±0.42
post 49 1485 685 46.1 0.52±0.46

3 Figures

3.1 general dynamics

Code 
p_wd_d <- dat_b |> 
  mutate(weekday = weekdays(date),
         wd2 = wday(date, week_start = 1))  |> 
  group_by(wd2, weekday) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(can_b*100),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_b*100)/sqrt(n()))

p_wd <- dat_b |> 
  mutate(weekday = weekdays(date),
         wd2 = wday(date, week_start = 1)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = can_b*100, x = wd2)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F, colour = "black") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(y = m, ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), data = p_wd_d) + 
  labs(#title = "a)",
    x = "weekday",
    y = "consumption day [%]") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
    legend.position.inside = c(.01,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.01,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:7, labels = c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"))

p_wd
Code 
ggsave(p_wd, filename = "figs/can_dy.jpeg", height = 4, width = 6, dpi = 300)

3.2 legalisation

Code 
p_leg_jd <- dat_b |> 
  mutate(jd = factor(jd, levels = c("end of year", "start of year"))) |> 
  group_by(leg, jd) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(can_b*100),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_b*100)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = jd, group = leg)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.1)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
  labs(title = "a)",
    x = "new year",
    y = "consumption day [%]") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(.~leg) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
    legend.position.inside = c(.99,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.99,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette)


p_leg_hd <- dat_b |> 
  mutate(hd = factor(ifelse(hd=="hd0", "non-holiday", "holiday"), levels = c("non-holiday", "holiday"))) |> 
  group_by(leg, hd) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(can_b*100),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_b*100)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = leg, group = hd, colour = hd)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.2)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.2)) +
  labs(title = "b)",
    x = "legalization", 
    y = "consumption day [%]",
    colour = "holiday") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(.01,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.01,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette[3:4])

p_leg_a1_d <- dat_l |> 
  mutate(Age = cut(age,5)) |>
  group_by(leg, Age) |> 
  reframe(N = n_distinct(Subj),
          n = n(),
          m = mean(can_g),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_g)/sqrt(n()), 
    age = mean(age))

p_leg_a1 <- dat_l |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = can_g, x = age, group = leg, colour = leg)) +

    y = "consumed cannabis [g/consumtion day]",
    colour = "legalization") +

3.3 setting

Code 
contrasts(dat_l$gender2) <-  MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$hd) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$jd) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$wd) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$set_b) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$loc_b) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$group_b) <- MASS::contr.sdif(2)
contrasts(dat_l$leg) <- contr.treatment(2)

model3 <- lmer(
  can_l ~ leg * (wd + jd + hd + loc_b + set_b + group_b + gender2 + a1) + (1 | Subj),
  data = dat_l)

p_set <- dat_l |> 
  group_by(group_b) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(can_g),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_g)/sqrt(n()),
    group2 = "group") |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = group_b, group = group2)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.1)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
  labs(title = "a)",
    x = "", 
    y = "consumed cannabis [g/consumtion day]") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(.~group2) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,2), guide = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
    legend.position.inside = c(.99,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.99,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1))

p_set_leg <- dat_l |> 
  mutate(paref = remef::keepef(model3, keep.intercept = T, fix= c(2:18), ran = NULL),
    paref = exp(paref)) |> 
  mutate(paref = paref + (mean(can_g) - mean(paref))) |> 
  pivot_longer(c(loc_b,set_b)) |> 
  group_by(name, value, leg) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(paref),
    ci = 1.96*sd(paref)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  mutate(value = factor(value, levels = c("not outdoors", "outdoors", "not public", "public")),
    name = factor(case_when(name == "loc_b" ~ "location",
      name == "set_b" ~ "setting"), levels = c("location", "setting"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = value, group = leg, colour = leg)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.1)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
  labs(title = "b)",
    x = "", 
    y = "",
    colour = "legalization") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(.~name, scales = "free") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,2), guide = "none") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(.01,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.01,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01), limits = c(.4,.55), breaks=seq(0.4,0.65,0.05))

plot_set <- p_set + p_set_leg + plot_layout(widths = c(1,2))
plot_set
Code 
ggsave(plot_set, filename = "figs/leg_set.jpeg", height = 4, width = 8, dpi = 300)

4 Appendix

Code 
p_g1 <- dat_l |> 
  mutate(paref = remef::keepef(model3, keep.intercept = T, fix= c(2:18), ran = NULL),
    paref = exp(paref)) |> 
  mutate(paref = paref + (mean(can_g) - mean(paref))) |> 
  group_by(leg, gender2) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(paref),
    ci = 1.96*sd(paref)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = leg, group = gender2, colour = gender2)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.2)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.2)) +
  labs(title = "a)",
    x = "legalization",
    y = "consumed cannabis [g/consumtion day]",
    colour = "true binary") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(.01,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.01,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette[6:7])

model3_g <- lmer(
  can_l ~ leg * (wd + jd + hd + loc_b + set_b + group_b + gender + a1) + (1 | Subj),
  data = dat_l |> filter(gender %in% c("woman","man")))


p_g2 <- dat_l |>
  filter(gender %in% c("woman","man")) |> 
  mutate(paref = remef::keepef(model3_g, keep.intercept = T, fix= c(2:18), ran = NULL),
    paref = exp(paref)) |> 
  mutate(paref = paref + (mean(can_g) - mean(paref))) |> 
  group_by(leg, gender) |> 
  reframe(m = mean(paref),
    ci = 1.96*sd(paref)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  mutate(gender = factor(gender, levels = c("woman", "man"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = leg, group = gender, colour = gender)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.2)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.2)) +
  labs(title = "b)",
    x = "legalization",
    y = "",
    colour = "social binary") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(.01,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.01,.99)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cbPalette[c(6,8)])

plot_gender <- p_g1 + p_g2
plot_gender
Code 
ggsave(plot_gender, filename = "figs/supp_leg_gen.jpeg", height = 4, width = 8, dpi = 300)

4.1 setting figures using raw values

p_set_leg <- dat_l |> 
  pivot_longer(c(loc_b,set_b)) |>

  reframe(m = mean(can_g),
    ci = 1.96*sd(can_g)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  mutate(value = factor(value, levels = c("outdoors", "not outdoors", "public", "not public")),

    colour = "legalization") +

  theme(legend.position = "inside",

4.2 consumed amounts: age [group] * legalisation

Code 
p_leg_age4 <- dat_l |> 
  select(Subj, age) |> 
  unique() |> 
  mutate(age_group = cut_number(age, 4)) |> 
  left_join(dat_l) |> 
  group_by(age_group, leg) |> 
  reframe(n = n_distinct(Subj),
          m = mean(can_g),
          ci = 1.96*sd(can_g)/sqrt(n())) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = m, x = leg, group = age_group, colour = age_group)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = m-ci, ymax = m+ci), position = position_dodge(.1)) + 
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(.1)) +
  labs(title = "",
    x = "", 
    y = "consumed cannabis [g/consumtion day]",
    colour = "age group") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#009E73",
paste0("#", 
       sqrt((as.hexmode("00")^2 + as.hexmode("00")^2 + as.hexmode("E6")^2) / 3), 
       sqrt((as.hexmode("9E")^2 + as.hexmode("9E")^2 + as.hexmode("9F")^2) / 3),
       sqrt((as.hexmode("73")^2 + as.hexmode("73")^2 + as.hexmode("00")^2) / 3)),
paste0("#", 
       sqrt((as.hexmode("00")^2 + as.hexmode("E6")^2 + as.hexmode("E6")^2) / 3), 
       sqrt((as.hexmode("9E")^2 + as.hexmode("9F")^2 + as.hexmode("9F")^2) / 3),
       sqrt((as.hexmode("73")^2 + as.hexmode("00")^2 + as.hexmode("00")^2) / 3)),
"#E69F00")) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(.99,.99),
    legend.justification.inside = c(.99,.99))

Code 
dat_l |> 
  select(Subj, age) |> 
  unique() |> 
  mutate(age_group = cut_number(age, 4)) |> 
  left_join(dat_l) |> 
  group_by(age_group, leg) |> 
  reframe(can_g = paste0(format(round(mean(can_g),2),nsmall=2),"±", round(1.96*sd(can_g)/sqrt(n()),2))) |> 
  spread(leg, can_g) |> 
  mutate(diff = as.numeric(substr(post,1,4)) - as.numeric(substr(pre,1,4))) |> 
  left_join(dat_l |> 
              select(Subj, age) |> 
              unique() |> 
              mutate(age_group = cut_number(age, 4)) |> 
              left_join(dat_l) |> 
              group_by(age_group) |> 
              reframe(N = n_distinct(Subj))) |> 
  select(age_group, N, pre, post, diff) |> 
  gt()
